description: Play a Routepot puzzle ($0.10) with a route from its start to its target token and learn at once whether it won a multiple of the entry. The better the route, the better the odds; each puzzle's rules give the multiples, odds and rake in force.

puzzle.description: A puzzle id from GET /v1/game/puzzle, open for the minutes its rules give and played once
